f177a55bf75a.curator_note: One of her tracked names playing a real room — the bass playing alone justifies the Palladium ticket, Brainfeeder jazz-funk at its most virtuosic.
f177a55bf75a.description: Thundercat's 'Distracted AF' tour hits the Hollywood Palladium, with support from fera.

artist_notes.name: Cinthie
artist_notes.note: Berlin house DJ/producer, founder of Beste Modus and Unison Wax and a resident at [IPSE] and Humboldthain — known specifically for vinyl-only, deep-yet-bassy house sets. Exactly the European-vinyl-house figure this taste tracks (in the same orbit as Antal/Job Jobse).

c67b2a997351.curator_note: TBA-location, all-night vinyl house set from a real figurehead of the Berlin scene — this is about as dead-on the rooftop/vinyl/groove/European lane as an afterhours booking gets.
c67b2a997351.description: Midnight Lovers books an all-night, vinyl-only house set from Berlin's Cinthie (Beste Modus) at a TBA DTLA location.

artist_notes.name: Mark Farina
artist_notes.note: Chicago-born, SF-based house legend behind the long-running 'Mushroom Jazz' series — a jazzy, downtempo-inflected strain of house he's been refining since the mid-90s.

artist_notes.name: Josh Wink
artist_notes.note: Philadelphia techno/house legend ('Higher State of Consciousness') and Ovum Recordings co-founder since 1994 — still a headline-level booking three decades in.

artist_notes.name: DJ Dazy
artist_notes.note: LA house DJ since 1992 — founded the all-female Sister DJs collective, deep and soulful vinyl-rooted sets, part of the West Coast house lineage this bill leans on.

artist_notes.name: Your Unkle Magik
artist_notes.note: Vinyl-only house selector, a regular on the Certified Groovers/DTLA open-air circuit.

artist_notes.name: Tom Carle
artist_notes.note: LA underground DJ working deep/minimal tech-house and techno — longtime host of a DJ podcast since 2018, regular alongside DJ Sneak and J-Dub on the CHI♡LA circuit.

4ecd0fcd718a.curator_note: A three-day house marathon built around DJ Sneak's birthday with Derrick Carter, Mark Farina and Josh Wink on the bill — this is Chicago-house royalty depth you don't see stacked this thick very often, TBA location aside.
4ecd0fcd718a.description: Multi-day (Sat 4pm–Mon 2am) house celebration for DJ Sneak's birthday, TBA location, with Derrick Carter, Mark Farina, Josh Wink, DJ Heather, John Tejada and a deep bench of Chicago-rooted house DJs.

artist_notes.name: Ferry Corsten
artist_notes.note: Dutch trance OG since the late-90s boom (System F, Gouryella with a young Tiësto) who now runs his own Flashover label and plays a broader, more contemporary progressive-leaning set.

artist_notes.name: Artbat
artist_notes.note: Ukrainian duo (Artur Kryvenko & Vitalii Limarenko) — melodic techno breakout via Solomun's Diynamic label ('Upperground', 'Atlas'); one of the names most responsible for melodic techno's mainstream crossover.

artist_notes.name: Enrico Sangiuliano
artist_notes.note: Italian techno producer, one of Drumcode's biggest-selling artists for a stretch (Adam Beyer's label) — hypnotic, sci-fi-tinged peak-time techno built for big rooms.

artist_notes.name: BT
artist_notes.note: Brian Transeau — one of American trance's founding names since the late-90s, still touring a big, cinematic, melody-forward sound.

0805854dd8f8.curator_note: Trance is mostly outside the lane, but this is the genre's biggest annual SoCal gathering, and Artbat and Enrico Sangiuliano's melodic-techno sets are a real reason to go beyond nostalgia for Above & Beyond and Ferry Corsten.
0805854dd8f8.description: Insomniac's SoCal trance festival, headlined by Above & Beyond and Ferry Corsten with melodic-techno crossover sets from Artbat and Enrico Sangiuliano.

artist_notes.name: Luke Strand
artist_notes.note: Bay Area-raised, LA-based vocalist/multi-instrumentalist (bass, guitar, keys, trumpet) who teaches at Musicians Institute Hollywood — leads this free weekly soul/jazz/R&B hang covering decades of hits with a rotating band.

087184be27c5.curator_note: A free weekly jam-session hang, not a headline show — good for a walk-in Los Feliz night if you're already out, not for building plans around.
087184be27c5.description: No-cover weekly soul/jazz jam session at The Dresden led by vocalist-multi-instrumentalist Luke Strand, with rotating guest musicians (8:30pm).

artist_notes.name: Kids in America
artist_notes.note: Touring '80s new-wave/pop tribute band (originally out of Charlotte, NC) covering hits from the decade — not an original act, so genre is pop covers rather than the venue's usual punk/rock.

10e5a0affe9c.curator_note: This is the touring '80s tribute act, not a real band — right in the cover-band/nostalgia-night bucket the taste profile skips regardless of venue.
10e5a0affe9c.description: Touring '80s new-wave/pop tribute band 'Kids in America' plays Permanent Records Roadhouse with a special-guest opener.

artist_notes.name: Luke Strand
artist_notes.note: LA vocalist/multi-instrumentalist (bass, guitar, keys) and Musicians Institute vocal faculty — R&B/neo-soul/jazz background, leads this loose covers-and-originals jam.

16fbd16dcbe0.curator_note: Luke Strand's a legit working musician, but this is a no-cover, low-stakes jam-session night — pleasant if you're already at the Dresden, not something to route a night around.
16fbd16dcbe0.description: No-cover soulful jazz jam session led by vocalist/multi-instrumentalist Luke Strand at The Dresden.

artist_notes.name: David Moscoe
artist_notes.note: LA jazz pianist/arranger who's hosted this 'Swingin' Jazz Affair' crooner night at the Dresden for years — old-Hollywood lounge-jazz territory.

1dad82afaaaa.curator_note: David Moscoe's a genuine fixture of the Dresden's jazz-night rotation; Matt Forbes and Jesse Goddard (the vocalists this time) don't turn up any bio beyond the listing, but the trio backing them is the real thing.
1dad82afaaaa.description: Recurring 'Swingin' Jazz Affair' crooner night at The Dresden — Matt Forbes and Jesse Goddard with the David Moscoe Trio.

artist_notes.name: David Moscoe
artist_notes.note: The Dresden's house bandleader — his trio anchors the venue's biweekly no-cover jazz/crooner nights alongside rotating singers.

0e741ea91ee8.curator_note: The Dresden's no-cover weekly jazz quartet is dependable, unpretentious background-to-foreground jazz — good for a casual Los Feliz night out, not a destination booking.
0e741ea91ee8.description: Weekly no-cover instrumental jazz quartet led by David Moscoe with rotating guests at The Dresden.

sounds_like: Cell Injection's raw, stripped-down techno lineage

artist_notes.name: Chris Liebing
artist_notes.note: German techno veteran since the early-'90s Frankfurt scene, founder of the purist techno label/podcast CLR — a genuine headline-tier name (Awakenings, Time Warp) known for dark, driving, relentless sets; a 5-hour set is a real event, not a normal tour-stop hour.

artist_notes.name: Truncate
artist_notes.note: David Flores — LA producer and co-founder of OBSERVE (with Moe Espinosa/Drumcell); raw, hypnotic, groove-driven techno that's played Berghain, fabric, Concrete and Awakenings. This is his own party's anniversary, not a guest slot.

artist_notes.name: OKTAFORM
artist_notes.note: Recurring visual artist for OBSERVE's parties (also did visuals for their 2024 Speedy J/Drumcell edition) — no separate DJ/production profile found.

1973e2ff27d8.curator_note: OBSERVE has quietly been one of LA's most credible techno institutions for 24 years now — Truncate co-founded it, and getting Chris Liebing to play a 5-hour set for the anniversary instead of a standard hour is exactly the kind of immersive booking worth planning a warehouse night around.
1973e2ff27d8.description: 24th-anniversary edition of OBSERVE, the long-running LA techno party co-founded by Truncate, at a TBA DTLA location — a 5-hour Chris Liebing headline set with Truncate and OKTAFORM visuals, 11pm start.

artist_notes.name: Luciid
artist_notes.note: Irish producer (Luke Pollock) and founder of the AGONY imprint — a genuine Beatport-charting schranz/hard-techno name; sets typically build from groove into 145-150bpm techno before tipping into schranz.

artist_notes.name: Callush
artist_notes.note: Berlin-based producer (Carolina Z.) running her own label Riot Tapes — dark industrial techno shot through with EBM and trance, a real fixture on the European hard-techno circuit (DGTL, Mixmag Germany features).

33e5af58ccce.curator_note: Hard techno/schranz isn't the core lane, but Luciid and Callush are both legit names in that world — this is the booking for the rare night you want the harder, faster end of European techno instead of groove.
33e5af58ccce.description: Afterhours hard-techno/schranz night at Exchange LA with touring acts Luciid and Callush, 10pm-3am.

artist_notes.name: Luke Strand
artist_notes.note: Bay Area-raised, LA-based vocalist/multi-instrumentalist (bass, guitar, keys, trumpet) who teaches at Musicians Institute Hollywood — leads this free weekly soul/jazz/R&B hang with a rotating band.

4b32c4ee71e4.curator_note: Same low-key no-cover Dresden hang as always — decent filler for a quiet weeknight, not something to build plans around.
4b32c4ee71e4.description: No-cover weekly soul/jazz jam session at The Dresden led by vocalist-multi-instrumentalist Luke Strand, with rotating guest musicians.

artist_notes.name: Seven Lions
artist_notes.note: Jeff Montalvo — melodic dubstep/bass pioneer and Ophelia Records founder; the genre-defining name pulling this bill outside the house/techno lane.

artist_notes.name: TOKiMONSTA
artist_notes.note: LA producer (Jennifer Lee) — Grammy-nominated future-beat/bass artist and one of the first women to headline a Coachella mainstage set; genre-blending rather than straight house/techno.

artist_notes.name: Tchami
artist_notes.note: French DJ/producer who coined 'future house' and runs the Confession label/party brand — the more house-leaning name on an otherwise bass-heavy bill.

artist_notes.name: Oliver Heldens
artist_notes.note: Dutch producer — broke out with 2014's 'Gecko,' a future-house pioneer alongside Tchami; also runs a deeper techno alias, HI-LO.

artist_notes.name: Gordo
artist_notes.note: Formerly Carnage — the trap/EDM producer rebranded into house a few years back and now runs with the Solid Grooves crowd; a genuine lane-shift, not just a rename.

artist_notes.name: Flosstradamus
artist_notes.note: Chicago duo (Curt Cameruci, Josh Young) — one of the acts that built festival trap in the early 2010s, still a heavy bass-stage draw.

artist_notes.name: Mija
artist_notes.note: LA bass/house DJ-producer in the Brownies & Lemonade orbit — eclectic, genre-hopping sets that land more bass-forward than house.

artist_notes.name: R3hab
artist_notes.note: Dutch big-room/progressive house DJ-producer (Cyb3rpvnk) — festival-mainstage staple for over a decade.

artist_notes.name: Archie Hamilton
artist_notes.note: London DJ/producer/label owner — an early architect of a rugged, atmospheric minimal-house-and-techno sound; MicroHertz label boss and a Paradise Ibiza regular.

artist_notes.name: James Hype
artist_notes.note: UK tech-house/bass-house DJ-producer — viral 'Ferrari' remix and a PIRATE Copenhagen resident; crossed from underground tech-house into a full mainstage festival draw.

artist_notes.name: Ranger Trucco
artist_notes.note: Michigan-born tech-house producer/vocalist, Space Yacht signee — clean, warbling tech-house with his own sung hooks.

artist_notes.name: TOBEHONEST
artist_notes.note: LA-based tech-house DJ/producer on the come-up — Latin-groove/hip-hop-inflected sound with Beatport Top 100 releases and cosigns from Chris Lake and John Summit.

artist_notes.name: TroyBoi
artist_notes.note: UK bass/trap producer known for a distinctive chopped-vocal sound — a big mainstage draw in the bass-music world, outside the house/techno lane.

artist_notes.name: Walker & Royce
artist_notes.note: LA house/tech-house duo — Dirtybird-adjacent, quirky vocal-driven house cuts; a home-turf name on this bill.

535f6e34e59c.curator_note: Insomniac's flagship NYE blowout at NOS — DJ Snake, Alesso and Marshmello are real headliners, and there's a genuine house/tech-house thread running through Gordo, Walker & Royce and TOBEHONEST, but most of this 30-deep bill is bass/trap/dubstep mainstage stuff, not a selector's set. Go for the production and the countdown, not the DJing.
535f6e34e59c.description: Insomniac's Countdown NYE 2026 at NOS Event Center — a 30-plus-artist multi-stage lineup headlined by DJ Snake, Alesso and Marshmello, running house through bass/trap into midnight.

artist_notes.name: Shefa
artist_notes.note: Couldn't verify a substantive bio — no confirmed public profile as a touring DJ; treat as unproven/local until more turns up.

7d19c33e6d96.curator_note: Paradisco is KKBB's standing monthly disco night, and 'Shefa' doesn't turn up as a bio-able name anywhere — worth knowing it exists, not worth planning a night around yet.
7d19c33e6d96.description: Paradisco, the recurring monthly disco night at Kiss Kiss Bang Bang (Koreatown), with Shefa; free, 10pm-2am.

423855c65a48.curator_note: Outside the lane entirely — the annual iHeartRadio pop mega-bill, not a DJ set or a rep screening — but Olivia Rodrigo is a genuine arena headliner if mainstream pop is ever on the table.
423855c65a48.description: iHeartRadio's annual Jingle Ball pop radio show at Intuit Dome, headlined by Olivia Rodrigo with Hilary Duff, RAYE, OneRepublic and more.

c9505e7363e5.curator_note: John Summit soloing the Coliseum is as big as tech-house gets in this city right now — no support acts announced yet, but this is exactly the mainstream end of the lane that's priority, not noise.
c9505e7363e5.description: John Summit headlines his CTRL Escape Tour solo at the LA Memorial Coliseum; no supporting acts listed yet.

artist_notes.name: Loukeman
artist_notes.note: Toronto producer/multi-instrumentalist (Luke Fenton) — lo-fi, pitch-shifted outsider house blurring house, R&B and indietronica; has collaborated with A$AP Rocky, Aminé, PinkPantheress and MIKE. A crate-digger pick, not a big-room name.

artist_notes.name: Dyltwosix
artist_notes.note: LA experimental rap/producer and regular collaborator with Loukeman's crew (BRXZN WXRLD nights) — local scene support rather than a solo draw.

2ebe9eeb4c8e.curator_note: Loukeman's outsider, pitch-shifted take on house pulls from a genuinely interesting corner (A$AP Rocky and PinkPantheress collabs, not club-circuit credentials), paired here with regular collaborator Dyltwosix on a TBA-location Lights Down Low night — more about the crate-digging than a big billing.
2ebe9eeb4c8e.description: Lights Down Low afterhours party at a TBA DTLA location with Toronto producer Loukeman and LA's Dyltwosix.

artist_notes.name: 2hollis
artist_notes.note: LA-raised rage-rap/hyperpop artist (Hollis Frazier-Herndon) on Interscope — self-produced, genre-blurring pop/rap/EDM chaos out of the Playboi Carti/Opium orbit, not a house/techno name.

artist_notes.name: Magdalena Bay
artist_notes.note: LA synth-pop duo (Mica Tenenbaum & Matthew Lewin) — lush, maximalist, internet-fluent synth-pop (Mercurial World, Imaginal Disk); more pop than club but electronic-production-obsessed.

artist_notes.name: Jane Remover
artist_notes.note: Hyperpop/digicore pioneer turned shoegaze — restless genre-hopper (Frailty, Census Designated, Revengeseekerz); a cult name in the extremely-online electronic underground.

329555770a3c.curator_note: Tyler's own festival at Dodger Stadium, and the bill leans further from straight rap than usual this year — Turnstile bring real hardcore-crossover energy, Magdalena Bay and 2hollis pull toward the synth/hyperpop end — worth going in with genre expectations loose rather than treating it as a hip-hop show.
329555770a3c.description: Tyler, The Creator's annual Camp Flog Gnaw festival at Dodger Stadium — Turnstile, Steve Lacy, Future, Don Toliver and a wide, genre-hopping bill.

4edb53aea20f.curator_note: A proper street takeover, not a club date — Solomun closing down Hollywood Blvd for a sunset-into-night open-air set is a different animal than his usual room booking, and he's exactly the deep/tech-house all-rounder this lane is built around.
4edb53aea20f.description: Solomun plays a street-closure open-air set on Hollywood Blvd, 5pm-11pm.

artist_notes.name: Noizu
artist_notes.note: UK-born, now LA-based tech-house producer (Jacob Plant) — runs his own label TECHNE Records, broke through via Chris Lake/Skrillex's HOWSLA and the platinum single 'Summer 91.' Crowd-pleasing but well-crafted tech-house.

6ae52304c414.curator_note: Noizu's tech-house is genuinely well-made — 'Summer 91' wasn't a fluke — but this is a routine Costa Mesa club date, not a special booking, and it's a real trek from Silver Lake.
6ae52304c414.description: Tech-house producer Noizu headlines Time Nightclub in Costa Mesa.

artist_notes.name: Ben Klock
artist_notes.note: Berghain resident and Ostgut Ton regular, the hypnotic, driving end of Berlin techno.

artist_notes.name: Blawan
artist_notes.note: UK producer whose raw, bass-heavy techno sits closer to the Hessle Audio/Ternesc side of things.

artist_notes.name: Gerd Janson
artist_notes.note: Running Back boss, a Frankfurt digger who moves between disco, house and weirder club music.

artist_notes.name: East End Dubs
artist_notes.note: UK techno and tech-house producer with a groove-first, rolling sound.

e04d22c5b5d3.curator_note: Three days of Time Warp in a DTLA studio complex, with Klock, Hawtin, Gerd Janson, Loco Dice and the Martinez Brothers all on one bill. It's pricey at $180+, but it's the closest LA gets to a proper European techno weekend, and the Friday 2pm start suggests a long one.
e04d22c5b5d3.description: Three-day Time Warp (Factory 93) techno and house festival at Ace*Mission Studios, Friday afternoon through Sunday 2am, with a 38-act lineup.

artist_notes.name: Osunlade
artist_notes.note: Founder of Yoruba Records, a spiritual, soulful deep-house producer and DJ known for his Ibiza and Detroit connections.

artist_notes.name: Marques Wyatt
artist_notes.note: West Coast deep-house figure who ran LA's long-running DEEP party.

artist_notes.name: Big Cee
artist_notes.note: Longtime resident opening DJ at Marques Wyatt's DEEP and a foundational figure in LA house.

78e261816535.curator_note: Osunlade playing deep house in the Lodge Room, which is only a short drive from home, with the Marques Wyatt/Big Cee DEEP crew alongside him. At $39 it's a cheap way to see a deep-house legend in a small room, and the night before Thanksgiving is a fun time for it.
78e261816535.description: DEEP-LA 360 Experience at the Lodge Room in Highland Park, with Osunlade, Marques Wyatt and Big Cee playing deep house.

artist_notes.name: Helena Hauff
artist_notes.note: Hamburg techno and electro DJ, hard and acid-leaning, Ninja Tune and Tresor orbit.

artist_notes.name: Ben Klock
artist_notes.note: Berghain resident and Ostgut Ton artist, a defining voice of the Berlin sound.

artist_notes.name: HAAi
artist_notes.note: London DJ and producer, psychedelic techno on Targ and Mute.

c32486b5b19c.curator_note: This is Time Warp, the Mannheim techno institution, landing in LA with Hawtin, Klock and Hauff on one bill. It's a rare chance to hear that European sound at festival scale, and the fact that the first two are on your tracked list makes it an easy yes. Expect it to be a long night.
c32486b5b19c.description: Time Warp's LA edition at Ace Mission Studios, a Berlin and Mannheim-style techno bill with Richie Hawtin, Ben Klock, Loco Dice, The Martinez Brothers, Helena Hauff and more.

artist_notes.name: Deorro
artist_notes.note: LA-raised big-room house producer, now mixing in Latin club and regional Mexican crossovers.

67b8e31adcbd.curator_note: This is the Chula Vista amphitheater, not LA (the neighborhood tag is wrong), so it's a real drive south. The bill is big-room and Latin crossover, not the groove you usually go for, so only worth it if you want the spectacle.
67b8e31adcbd.description: Deorro with Alacranes Musical at the North Island Credit Union Amphitheatre in Chula Vista, near San Diego.

artist_notes.name: Will Sparks
artist_notes.note: Australian producer who helped popularize Melbourne bounce, a pounding electro-house offshoot.

6fbd5f16ec49.curator_note: Will Sparks is Melbourne bounce, which is loud, bouncy and built for big rooms rather than deep grooves. Fun at Exchange if you want a peak-hour romp, but it's not European club music.
6fbd5f16ec49.description: Melbourne-bounce and electro-house DJ Will Sparks at Exchange LA, 10pm-3am.

artist_notes.name: Dekmantel Soundsystem
artist_notes.note: Touring format of Amsterdam's Dekmantel label/festival, a taste-maker house, techno and electro-leaning selection.

99b3c7d33792.curator_note: Dekmantel bringing its soundsystem format to LA is the closest thing here to a proper European club night, and the selection is the point. Easy yes for the fabric-style crowd, with a TBA location to keep an eye on.
99b3c7d33792.description: Midnight Lovers hosts Amsterdam's Dekmantel Soundsystem with Make A Dance, house and techno at a DTLA-area location.

artist_notes.name: Massano
artist_notes.note: Progressive/melodic house and techno producer; this is billed as a 360-degree set, an in-the-round format.

artist_notes.name: Township Rebellion
artist_notes.note: Melodic techno/house act in the Lane 8/Afterlife-adjacent sound; details unverified.

a0dfb0bcd768.curator_note: A 360-degree set puts the DJ in the middle of the room, which suits this kind of long, building progressive sound. A good melodic night if the warmer, hands-up side of the lane is what you want.
a0dfb0bcd768.description: Massano plays a 360-degree progressive and melodic techno set with Township Rebellion at Exchange LA.

artist_notes.name: Hot Since 82
artist_notes.note: UK house heavyweight, Knee Deep In Sound boss - rolling, hypnotic, long-set sensibility.

9b53596f2eb9.curator_note: February is a long way off, but a Hot Since 82 late set is the kind of thing worth putting on the calendar now. He is at his best when given room to build, and a 10-to-3 slot should give him that.
9b53596f2eb9.description: Late-night Hot Since 82 set at Reframe Studios, a Framework production.

5cfd176b0544.description: Electronic producer Bonobo in concert at The Wiltern, Koreatown (7pm, $37+).

982da1536368.description: Latin musician Edgar Alejandro at Pacific Electric in DTLA (8pm).

edbbb171fc23.description: Musician Stephen Day with Elysia Biro at El Rey Theatre, Mid-Wilshire (8pm).

7abd01aaa04c.description: Theatre touring production of The Who's Tommy at Hollywood Pantages (7:30pm).

5ef962ded059.description: Drag show Wild Wednesdays at Hamburger Mary's in Long Beach (7:30pm).

61fe7dd2ffd5.description: The Psychedelic Furs with Gary Numan at Fox Performing Arts Center, Riverside (8pm).

0b25df43b3b7.description: Oh, Mary! touring production at Ahmanson Theatre (7:30pm).

30f16f2910b6.description: Pedro Fernández performs at Yaamava Theater (8pm, 21+).

cf6cd35ddcc5.description: KCRW presents Bonobo's Distance in Static North American tour at The Wiltern in Koreatown, 7pm.

1293da022a87.description: Pop singer Sienna Spiro's My House Tour with special guest Summer Joy at the Orpheum Theatre in DTLA, 8pm.

ce7be825114f.description: Hip-hop artist Finn Askew at The Moroccan Lounge in the Arts District, doors 9:30pm, all ages.

476762fa7151.description: Pop artist Mercer Henderson at The Echo in Echo Park, 7pm.

077115983059.description: Rodrigo y Gabriela, the Mexican guitar duo, at Libbey Bowl in Ojai, 7:30pm.

c655da39d137.description: Ninajirachi and MGNA Crrrta electronic show (house, dubstep, drum and bass) at The Fonda Theatre in Hollywood, 9pm, 18+.

582c005edfdc.description: Performance-art piece Destiny of Desire at the Mark Taper Forum in DTLA, 7:30pm.

1e63bc2702b1.description: Weekly Thursday night of saxophone-led instrumental jazz at The Dresden in Los Feliz, 8:30-11:30pm, no cover; Billy T and the Fam listed for Nov 12.

830cb6b4b67c.description: Edgar Alejandro, a Latin-listed act, live at Pacific Electric in DTLA at 8pm Nov 12.

7c5c1f3ad28c.description: Live electronic and world-music show by Sina Bathaie (White Lotus World Tour) at The Vermont in Hollywood, 7:30pm Nov 12, from $89.

cf37c1c1b78f.description: Leonid & Friends, an 11-piece collective that recreates Chicago's catalog alongside 1970s rock, pop and jazz-fusion hits, at the Fred Kavli Theatre in Thousand Oaks, 7:30pm Nov 12.

5707db63aad7.description: Touring stage production of Oh, Mary! at the Ahmanson Theatre in DTLA, 7:30pm Nov 12.

0b5064999470.description: Pop act Rivkah Reyes at The Peppermint Club in West Hollywood, doors 7pm Nov 12; 21+.

0d9bb7203ad4.description: Dear Evan Hansen staged at La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts, 7:30pm Nov 12.

daeaf637d379.description: Thursday drag show at Hamburger Mary's in Long Beach (not LA), 8pm Nov 12.

88e6d27437e5.description: Todd Day Wait punk/rock show at Permanent Records Roadhouse in Cypress Park, Thu 11/12 at 6pm; $15 advance, $18 at the door.

752dba961d4b.description: Lawrence with Family Company & Lindsey Lomis at The Novo in DTLA, Thu 11/12 at 7pm, listed as a rock show.

artist_notes.name: Dave Aju
artist_notes.note: SF producer (Marc Barrite), Circus Company artist — soulful, left-field house built from his own vocals; played Fabric and Panorama Bar.

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ with NTS and Dublab residencies — Italo, house and dancefloor edits.

artist_notes.name: SONNS
artist_notes.note: LA underground fixture behind Making Shapes and In Between; releases on Machine Limited and Kompakt.

artist_notes.name: Goddollars
artist_notes.note: Loren Granich, Rhonda co-founder and resident — sexy house-and-disco.

484e992f14f3.curator_note: Rhonda and In Between teaming up on an album release is about as close to a family reunion as this scene gets, and Dave Aju playing a free-ish 10am-to-4am marathon is the kind of deep booking you plan around. Venue is still TBA, so keep an eye out.
484e992f14f3.description: Day-into-night album release party for Navid Izadi's Ayande, presented by Rhonda Intl and In Between, with house and disco from Dave Aju, Masha Mar, SONNS and Goddollars.

2df5e879ef76.curator_note: No lineup posted, so this is a bet on the concept: a house-and-disco night at El Cid, ten minutes from home. Free before 10 with RSVP, so the downside is a couple of drinks.
2df5e879ef76.description: Recurring house and disco party at El Cid in Silver Lake; free with RSVP before 10pm.

325486f8268c.curator_note: Goth-industrial-techno costume rave at 1720, with no lineup yet. Fun if you like the darker, theatrical side; harder and more aesthetic-driven than the groovy European nights.
325486f8268c.description: Goth and industrial techno party from Nowwhere to Run and SOS at 1720 in the Arts District.

5fdd5d8f874c.curator_note: Free-with-RSVP night at Los Globos, but nobody is billed and bass house leans toward the stuff you skip. Only worth it if the lineup drops and surprises.
5fdd5d8f874c.description: Free-with-RSVP EMX electronic night at Los Globos; bass house and tech house, lineup unannounced.

8dff55d81f22.curator_note: A house night in the Bellwether's Camille's room the Friday after Thanksgiving, with no names attached yet. Ticketed at $24-30, so wait for the lineup before committing.
8dff55d81f22.description: Black House Radio house music night, 9pm-2am at Camille's at the Bellwether in DTLA.

artist_notes.name: Klangkarussell
artist_notes.note: Austrian duo, 'Sonnentanz' (2012) made them a melodic-house festival name.

95400a71d1d8.curator_note: Big 2012 crossover hit, now a melodic-house touring act that fills 1720. Pleasant and sing-along rather than deep, and $40+ for a headliner-only bill is a bit steep.
95400a71d1d8.description: Austrian melodic house duo Klangkarussell on their Americas 2027 tour at 1720.

cfa0a153347a.curator_note: Free all-nighter at an undisclosed spot an hour out, built on breaks, jungle, psytrance, hardstyle and gabber. The house is incidental; this one is the opposite of the groove you chase, and the drive is real.
cfa0a153347a.description: Free 9pm-5am multi-genre bass and hard-dance party by Psy Opalia at a TBA location outside LA.

daabd06bbcc6.curator_note: Free EP release night at Bar Franca, a small DTLA room where the sound system is the point. Local-scale, but a good low-risk Saturday for house and techno heads.
daabd06bbcc6.description: Release party for Spacious's Textural EP at Bar Franca with heelbite316 and Emackulate; free entry.

02f87f3c62b5.curator_note: A Wooli-weekend unofficial afters with a secret DTLA location, but it's riddim and bass all the way down. Only for the afterhours-and-mystery-address crowd; musically it's off your path.
02f87f3c62b5.description: Unofficial late-night afterparty for the Wooli weekend with a TBA downtown location, billed as dubstep, riddim and drum and bass.

0879eeff2b6a.curator_note: Gudfella is a name I can't vouch for, and the listing gives no support or label context. It's a standard Hollywood house night, so I'd only go if friends are already headed there.
0879eeff2b6a.description: Saturday-night house set at Sound Nightclub in Hollywood, 10pm to 2:30am.

artist_notes.name: Interplanetary Criminal
artist_notes.note: Manchester producer riding the UK bassline/2-step revival; skippy, rave-adjacent garage.

10331ea1cb44.curator_note: Interplanetary Criminal is a name already on your radar, and this one's at an off-the-grid-feeling address on Mission Rd. It's a bassline and garage night more than house, but that's a fun detour, and it's a long way off in February.
10331ea1cb44.description: UK garage and bassline producer Interplanetary Criminal with Osmosis Jones at 560 S Mission Rd.

artist_notes.name: Joyce Manor
artist_notes.note: Torrance-born emo/punk band, short punchy songs; a cult favorite.

artist_notes.name: The Linda Lindas
artist_notes.note: LA punk band of young musicians, Epitaph-signed, with a following well beyond local.

artist_notes.name: Interpol
artist_notes.note: NYC post-punk revival band from the early 2000s, moody and driving.

116c427531c7.curator_note: The annual KROQ Forum bill is stacked: Foo Fighters, Weezer, Sublime and Interpol in one night. It's an arena rock night rather than a club one, but Weezer is in your rotation and the post-punk end with Interpol is real.
116c427531c7.description: KROQ's annual holiday concert at the Kia Forum with Foo Fighters, Weezer, Sublime, Interpol, Joyce Manor and more.

artist_notes.name: Nic Fanciulli
artist_notes.note: UK tech-house and techno DJ who runs Saved Records; long-time festival and club mainstay.

artist_notes.name: Paco Osuna
artist_notes.note: Spanish techno/tech-house veteran, a Plus 8 and Intec regular; shown on the Dice listing as a co-headliner.

11a70262bce2.curator_note: Fanciulli and Paco Osuna on one Framework bill is two veteran tech-house and techno names playing for hours. This is probably the best straight-ahead dance floor in the batch. The $74+ ticket is steep, but it's the one I'd look at.
11a70262bce2.description: Framework presents Nic Fanciulli with Paco Osuna at Reframe Studios, 10pm to 2am.

15a46ec26e46.curator_note: Oden & Fatzo is a UK duo doing bouncy house with a garage edge. At $25 it's a cheap Avalon night, but expect big-room Hollywood energy rather than a proper European club.
15a46ec26e46.description: UK duo Oden & Fatzo at Avalon Hollywood playing house, electro and UK garage.

dj nuts.note: Sao Paulo crate-digger revered for his Brazilian/global-beats edits (Wax Poetics 'Cultura Copia' mixtapes) — deep, eclectic, all-vinyl selector.

cut chemist.note: LA turntablist, ex-Jurassic 5 / Ozomatli — sample-collage funk and breaks; a foundational figure in the city's beats scene.

waajeed.note: Detroit producer/DJ (Bling47, Dirt Tech Reck) and Slum Village affiliate — soulful house and beats that bridge Dilla's lineage into the dancefloor.

shdw.note: Co-founder of the Mutual Rytm label and half of German duo SHDW & Obscure Shape — driving, hypnotic, melodic-leaning techno; squarely the refined European end you like.

bradley zero.note: Founder of Peckham's Rhythm Section International and the long-running NTS show — a genuine tastemaker selector spanning disco, broken beat, deep house and global grooves. One of the better daytime sets you can catch in LA this weekend.

masha mar.note: Serbian-born, LA-based DJ/curator (the Midnight Lovers crew) with NTS and Dublab residencies — Italo disco, house and dancefloor edits.

neeko.note: Resident selector for Sunday Sessions LA, the vinyl-only series at Apotheke — all-wax house and disco.

krane.note: Longtime Sunday Sessions LA resident — vinyl-only house DJ recorded across the series' open-air sets.

ayybo.note: Rising US tech-house producer, big-room festival energy — exactly the mainstream-fun end of the lane, not noise.

ragie ban.note: Brazilian house producer signed to Lake's own Black Book; their flip 'Toxic' hit Beatport #1.

dj minx.note: Detroit house matriarch, Women on Wax founder — tracked artist; deep, soulful, dancefloor-first selection.

josh caffé.note: London house vocalist/DJ and Paranoid London frontman; Black queer club energy with records on Crosstown Rebels and Classic — proper fabric-lineage stuff.

farralone.note: LA disco/house selector — couldn't verify a label home, but the billing reads classic nu-disco-into-house warmth.

trovarsi.note: LA modular/live techno artist and educator (SoCal Synth Society) — bassy, hardware-driven sets that swing from pounding to melodic.

e m bae.note: Part of the Black Techno Matters collective lineup; couldn't verify a full bio, so taking that at face value.

92jelani.note: Black Techno Matters-affiliated DJ; limited public footprint, included per the billing.

hot since 82.note: UK house heavyweight, Knee Deep In Sound boss — tracked artist; rolling, hypnotic, extended-set sensibility that elevates the whole bill.

claude vonstroke.note: Dirtybird founder (aka Barclay Crenshaw) — playful, bass-heavy West Coast house; he's billed leading the 'Team USA' set here.

ardalan.note: Tehran-born, Bay Area-raised Dirtybird mainstay — hypnotic, deep-bass house out of the Sunset Sound System lineage.

todd edwards.note: New Jersey UK-garage legend ('God of Garage') who shaped Daft Punk's sound — chopped-vocal, skippy house.

cut snake.note: Australian house duo (Sedz & Leigh Sedley) — sunny, festival-ready CRSSD-circuit house.

falcons.note: LA producer/DJ working the club-and-bass-leaning end; included per the bill.

ak chamel the giver of illness.note: Anonymous Houston duo doing desert-scorched ritual-folk and lo-fi psychedelia — masked, costumed, occult live show; fits the Zebulon experimental lane more than the dance one.

derek monypeny.note: Joshua Tree guitarist/oud + shahi baaja player (ex-Sir Richard Bishop's Freak of Araby Ensemble) — drone-to-free-jazz 'desert continuum' soundscapes.

xica soul.note: LA DJ and radio host (Artform, KQBH) — soul, funk and house, an In Sheep's Clothing-circuit selector.

cassian.note: Australian producer, Grammy-winning mixer on RÜFÜS DU SOL's 'Alive' — dark-but-dreamy melodic house; the marquee draw here.

kamino.note: London/LA/Brooklyn house & tech-house producer; broke out with 'Lower Frequency,' melody-forward but dancefloor-aimed.

eddie c.note: Canadian-in-Berlin slo-mo disco-edits heavyweight (Edward Currelly) — lush, dubby, generous grooves on Endless Flight; runs the 7 Inches of Love imprint with The Mole. A tracked name and a perfect open-to-close selector.

b wade.note: Resident behind the recurring 'Acts of Service Sounds' soulful-house night at Gold Diggers — 'sounds for the soul, all night long,' classic vocal/gospel-tinged deep house.

lydo.note: NYC-based, BASEMENT resident and X-TRA.SERVICES founder — fast, syncopated, heady techno-trance from the queer underground.

frankie teardrop.note: Montreal DJ/curator (Slut Island festival, LIP party) — high-energy queer-underground techno and rave.

tamara lanza.note: LA multi-genre DJ and Level 8 / Sunset Sessions regular — ranges disco house through deep and melodic; reliable rooftop-groove selector.

antal.note: Rush Hour co-founder, Amsterdam — one of the deepest diggers alive; obscure disco, raw house, broken beat and beyond. Flying in for this. A tracked name.

reverberation radio.note: The Allah-Las' long-running weekly podcast and DJ crew — deep-crate '60s-onward psych, surf, folk-rock, soul and global obscurities played off the records (Calico Discos label).

richie hawtin.note: Windsor/Detroit-Berlin minimal-techno icon (Plastikman, F.U.S.E.; founder of Plus 8 and M_nus) — a defining name in stripped, hypnotic techno. A tracked name; this is a free art-context set, not a club.

john gerrard.note: Irish artist behind LACMA's year-long browser-based 'SPIRITS' artwork; this solstice event is its Summer (Mediterranean) activation — gerrard appears alongside Hawtin.

dave harrington.note: Half of Darkside (with Nicolas Jaar) and a fixture of LA's improv scene — guitar/electronics-led psychedelic jams; this is his quintet.

john dwyer.note: Frontman of Oh Sees / Osees — prolific garage-psych and experimental bandleader (Castle Face Records), here in a free-improv setting.

spencer zahn.note: Composer and double-bassist working in ambient-jazz and modern-classical textures (collaborations with Dawn Richard among others).

aaron steele.note: LA/Nashville drummer-percussionist (Chrome Sparks and others) — versatile, jazz-fusion-leaning player.

tom dolas.note: Keyboardist in Oh Sees and Mr. Elevator — psych and jazz-fusion-flavored synth and keys.

yaeji.note: Brooklyn-based, Korean-American producer/DJ (Kathy Yaeji Lee) — whispered bilingual vocals over deep house and club rhythms; debut LP 'What We Drew' on XL Recordings, second album 'With A Hammer' (2023). Breakthrough Boiler Room in 2017. On a dedicated DJ-set North American summer tour 2026. Tracked name.

alima lee.note: LA-based DJ and co-founder of the Baexploitation / Hood Rave orbit — global club, footwork-adjacent and deeply communal sets.

adam beyer.note: Swedish techno institution and Drumcode founder — driving, functional, peak-time techno; one of the most reliably excellent festival techno sets alive. Tracked name.

cloonee.note: Manchester-raised tech-house producer Dave Bissett (CLNE, Repopulate Mars, Sola) — Beatport #1s including 'Like What' and a Chris Lake collab 'Nightmares'; one of the circuit's best crowd-movers. Tracked name.

loco dice.note: Tunisian-German DJ Yassine Ben Achour, Düsseldorf — founder of Desolat; Space/Hi Ibiza resident; blends hip-hop textures and North African rhythms into house and tech house. Records on Ovum, M-nus, Cadenza, Cocoon.

hi-lo.note: Oliver Heldens' darker techno alias — HILOMATIK label boss; has released on Drumcode and deadmau5's mau5trap; melodic-peak techno bridging festival and underground.

elderbrook.note: London singer-producer Alexander Kotz — 'Cola' with CamelPhat was Grammy-nominated 2018; soulful voice over emotive deep house. Live-electronic act, not a DJ set.

hayden james.note: Sydney producer — polished, melodic house (multi-Platinum 'Something About You'); worked with Gorgon City and Katy Perry; RUFUS Du Sol-adjacent but slightly more radio-pop.

sidepiece.note: LA-based duo Party Favor + Nitti Gritti — their 2019 'On My Mind' was Grammy-nominated for Best Dance Recording; peak-time tech house with Motown and '90s soul edits.

westend.note: New York tech house producer Tyler Morris — helped define modern American tech house; Kick & Bass Records founder; recent single 'The Ceiling' on John Summit's Experts Only.

josh baker.note: Manchester DJ/producer and You&Me Records founder — groove-heavy fluid house and minimal; played fabric, DC10, The Warehouse Project; also runs SYNTHO production school.

riordan.note: South-coast UK rising producer — garage-influenced tech house; Beatport #1 'Needle On The Record' on Gorgon City's Realm; also on Black Book and Catch & Release.

greg 99.note: Brazilian producer from Minas Gerais — Latin and Afro-inflected tech house; Beatport #1 collab 'Still My Baby' with Cloonee (6.6M streams); Insomniac Records debut.

stacey pullen.note: Second-wave Detroit techno architect — studied under Derrick May, released on R&S, Transmat and Eclipse in the '90s; Blackflag Recordings founder; acclaimed DJ-Kicks (1996); also releases as Bango, Kosmik Messenger and Silent Phase. Tracked name.

bae bae.note: Kumi James — LA-born DJ/producer, sound artist, Planet Mu signee, and co-founder of Hood Rave (DTLA's queer-Black underground party). Sets weave footwork, juke, breaks and R&B through an explicitly Black-diasporic and femme lens; NTS and Dublab radio host.

nish.note: LA/Boracay-raised DJ — groove-forward soulful house and global rhythms with an intention-first approach; active in the Westside Bounce and LA underground circuits.

dj toka.note: Resident at Sudamericana, LA's long-running Latin dance party (founded 2012) — plays between classic South American rhythms, house and disco edits in an unpretentious, inclusive room.

robert hood.note: Detroit minimal-techno originator and M-Plant founder — co-founded Underground Resistance with Jeff Mills and Mad Mike Banks; stripped techno to bare drum/bassline essentials on 'Internal Empire' and 'Minimal Nation' (both 1994, Tresor/Axis). Also records as Floorplan (gospel-inflected house). Tracked name.

disco zombie.note: LA techno DJ and producer active in the WORK / Dirty Epic underground orbit — dark, groovy techno; co-hosts the @earlyafters show on KCHUNG Radio.

onyx.note: LA-based underground techno DJ, active on the WORK / INCOGNITO circuit; limited wider public footprint beyond local bookings.

rubbermiro.note: LA techno DJ (KCHUNG Radio earlyafters host alongside Disco Zombie) — dark, groovy underground techno; regular on the Dirty Epic / WORK circuit.

jayda g.note: Vancouver-born, London-based producer/DJ Jacinda Gulley — environmental toxicologist turned Grammy-nominated house and disco selector; two albums on Ninja Tune including 'Guy' (2023). An instinctive digger with genuine soul. Tracked name.

enayet.note: NYC-based, Dhaka-raised producer and SLINK co-founder — debut EP 'Chokkor' recorded in Bangladesh; polyrhythmic club music with South Asian vocal/percussion textures; collaborated with Daytimers and Talvin Singh.

k wata.note: NYC producer Kenzo Perron, SLINK co-founder — experimental grooves between warehouse electro, trap and psychedelic reggaeton; produced for Yaeji; contributed to james K 'Friend' remix album.

discostan.note: LA collective/label co-founded by Arshia Fatima Haq and Jeremy Loudenback — archives and decolonizes the dancefloor through South/West Asian and North African music: '80s diaspora disco, folkloric sounds, re-edits and political interventions. Featured in Pitchfork, The Guardian, KCRW.

pocari g.note: LA-based house DJ active on the local underground circuit; limited wider public footprint.

ashtre.note: LA-based selector on the local house/underground circuit; no verified label or broader profile found.

oso disco.note: LA disco/house DJ; included per billing, limited verifiable detail.

blaze claze.note: LA-based DJ; included per billing, no wider verifiable profile found.

halo varga.note: Brian Varga — Chicago-bred selector, one of fabric London's first resident DJs; releases on All Inn Records, Visionquest, Soma, Yoshitoshi; now San Diego-based and co-owner of Artifact Record Shop. Deep Chicago house roots with a European finish.

dylan payne.note: LA-based vinyl selector and Inthebagg label head — all-vinyl sets of house, microhouse and minimal grooves; Sunday Sessions LA regular.

highkin'.note: Moscow-born, LA-based vinyl collector and DJ — active on the LA underground circuit with an RA profile; limited wider public footprint beyond local bookings.

flying mojito bros.note: British duo Ben Chetwood and Jack Sellen — cosmic country-funk and classic rock reimagined as acid house and modern disco; releases on Ubiquity, Paper Recordings, !K7 and Heavenly. Think Crosby Stills and Nash at the Hacienda.

brainstory.note: LA trio (Inland Empire origin) — jazz-inflected neo-soul, psychedelia and hip-hop textures; primarily a live band, not a DJ act. Some groove DNA but a different lane from the dance floor.

ginger root.note: Cameron Lew's solo project from Huntington Beach — immaculately crafted indie soul, alt-disco, boogie and Japanese city pop; primarily a live band but occasionally performs DJ sets. Influences include Vulfpeck, Toro y Moi and Yellow Magic Orchestra.

eli escobar.note: New York house and disco veteran — 20+ years in the scene, Tiki Disco crew founding member, Night People NYC label boss; sets traverse soulful disco, jazzy house, funk, reggaeton and Afrobeat without losing the floor.

charlotte de witte.note: Belgian techno powerhouse, KNTXT label boss — hard, hypnotic peak-time techno; a tracked name and one of the strongest bookings on this lineup.

boys noize.note: Berlin electro/techno veteran (Alex Ridha) — distorted, industrial-leaning club music going back to the mid-2000s Boysnoize Records run; still a reliably weird, high-energy set.

maceo plex.note: Miami-via-Barcelona producer (Eric Estornel) — tech-house and techno crossover, Ellum Audio boss; deep, dark, groove-driven.

tiga.note: Montreal electro-house institution (Turbo Recordings) — tongue-in-cheek, disco-inflected electro; a real name for the older end of this bill.

vtss.note: Polish DJ/producer on the harder, rave-leaning end of techno — Bicep's Fabric label, T4T LUV NRG co-founder; a genuinely respected underground name amid the festival billing.

shygirl.note: UK rapper/vocalist and NUXXE co-founder — hyperpop-adjacent club music, Sega Bodega/Arca collaborator; more art-club than DJ set.

hannah laing.note: Scottish DJ/producer on the UK hard-house/hardcore-revival wave — high-BPM, rave-nostalgic tech house.

vintage culture.note: Brazilian tech-house export, Solotoko boss — tracked name; huge festival draw, big-room but genuinely well-selected house.

mau p.note: Dutch producer of 'Drugs From Amsterdam' fame — tracked name; big-room tech house with a raw, jacking edge.

dj seinfeld.note: Swedish-Argentine producer (Armand Jakobsson) who pioneered 'lo-fi house' — tracked name; hazy, nostalgic house that's a shade more tasteful than most of this bill.

chris lorenzo.note: UK bass/house producer, Half Baked label — tracked name; UK garage-inflected, bass-heavy house.

interplanetary criminal.note: Manchester producer riding the UK bassline/2-step revival — one of the more interesting names on the bill if you like that skippy, rave-adjacent garage sound.

amelie lens.note: Belgian techno star, Exhale label — tracked name; driving, hypnotic peak-time techno with real European club credibility (see also her own Grand Park date this batch).

andy c.note: UK drum & bass legend, RAM Records boss — outside the house/techno lane but a genuine, decades-deep DJ talent if you catch a set.

polo and pan.note: French duo (Paul Armand-Delille & Alexandre Grynszpan) doing lush, tropical-tinged synth-pop and disco touches — a strong, Balearic-adjacent opening act even if the headliner isn't your lane.

knock2.note: US producer straddling bass music and pop-leaning electronic — big festival-stage energy, outside the house/techno lane.

sacha robotti.note: Berlin-schooled, LA-based producer and Slothacid label founder — house/techno with releases on Dirtybird, Defected and Kompakt; his debut album drops on Dirtybird in 2026, so this booking tracks.

gg.note: Resident behind Townhouse Venice's recurring GOOD GAME party — deep house, hip-hop and global rhythms with rotating guest DJs; a westside underground night, not a marquee-name booking.

la riots.note: Daniel Linton's long-running LA tech-house project (started as a duo in 2007) — bloghouse/remix roots (Justice's 'DVNO'), now festival-circuit groove-driven house on Toolroom and Musical Freedom.

doc martin.note: West Coast house pioneer — moved SF to LA in the early '90s, founded the long-running Sublevel label/party (25 years deep in 2026); deep, tribal, acid-inflected house from a genuine scene elder.

lee burridge.note: UK DJ, founder of All Day I Dream — melodic, organic, Balearic-leaning house; about as close to the European sunset-groove reference point as a festival lineup gets.

justin martin.note: Dirtybird co-founder — bouncy, quirky, bass-inflected West Coast house ('Sasquatch', 'Buggin''); SF scene royalty.

radio slave.note: Matt Edwards' techier alias — Rekids co-founder, ex-Ministry of Sound resident; propulsive, muscular house/techno, a genuinely European-pedigreed booking.

mikey lion.note: Desert Hearts co-founder — psychedelic house/techno out of the SoCal camping-rave scene, warmer and trippier than straight club fare.

dj colette.note: Chicago house vocalist/DJ (Om Records, Skint) — classic Chicago-lineage vocal house, been in the game since the late '90s.

anton tumas.note: Subtract Music founder — deep house/techno/hypnotic-electronica selector who ran the beloved 'Subtract On The Pier' Long Beach series; genuinely well-regarded in the SoCal deep-house underground.

davi.note: Armenian-born, LA-based progressive house producer — early support from Hernan Cattaneo, Nick Warren, John Digweed; polished melodic-prog rather than raw underground.

luke mele.note: LA-based selector with a long-running NTS Radio show spanning Balearic house, dub techno, ambient and trip-hop — a genuine home-listening digger, exactly the vinyl-only lane you like.

taylor shockley.note: House/ambient/minimal/dub DJ with credits on Insomniac and Mixcloud — smaller name, limited verifiable bio beyond active gigging.

nick león.note: Miami producer on TraTraTrax and Future Times — fuses dembow, reggaeton and dancehall rhythm into house/techno (his own coined term: 'arquitectronica'); one of the more genuinely distinctive club producers right now, sun-bleached and heavy in equal measure.

demuir.note: Toronto-based, Chicago-schooled house producer — Beatport's #1 Jacking House producer 2015/2016, credited with creating the 'Jackin House' genre tag; 600+ tracks deep, releases on Hot Creations and Classic. Funky, sexy, groove-first house.

massimiliano pagliara.note: Italian-born, Berlin-based DJ/producer with residencies at Berghain/Basement — Chicago house, Italo-disco and electro-disco worked through analog '70s/'80s hardware; a genuine Live at Robert Johnson / Ostgut Ton pedigree, deeply in the European lane.

james axon.note: LA-based DJ (dublab resident, 'Hearing Color') and founder of the queer underground party Planet Love — deep house, dreamy techno, Italo, Balearic and psych-disco; a real musician's ear (former pianist), has played alongside Octo Octa, Eris Drew, Derrick Carter.

drama.note: Chicago R&B/dance duo — producer Na'el Shehade and vocalist Via Rosa — genre-blurring pop/dance/jazz songwriting; played Coachella alongside Frank Ocean and Gorillaz.

gene on earth.note: San Francisco-born, Berlin-based DJ/producer (Eugene Albert) — runs the Limousine Dream label; deep-digging extended sets drifting through minimal house, breaks and hazy late-night rollers.

collin reeve.note: LA house DJ, regular on the Certified Groovers series — limited verifiable bio beyond his own SoundCloud output and repeat bookings on the bill.

pan pot.note: Berlin duo (Tassilo Ippenberger & Thomas Benedix), Second State label bosses — big, weighty, driving techno; a genuine headliner for a 4-hour extended set.

doostah.note: LA house/techno DJ who works marketing for 6AM Group/WORK/Synthetik Minds — one of the promoters playing support, not an outside booking.

kitty logic.note: Hong Kong-born, LA-based DJ and TRANS*CENDENT co-founder who came up in the warehouse scene — driving techno and trance sets, on the harder/faster end of the spectrum.

neek.note: SoCal DJ/producer who's blown up fast in the hard-techno lane through viral edits and heavy, industrial-leaning production.

dea magna.note: LA techno/hard-techno producer, classically trained, releases on Reinier Zonneveld's Filth On Acid — fuses trance intensity with techno drive.

merimell.note: Estonian hard-techno DJ/producer, Machine Nation founder — one of the harder European exports, industrial textures and peak-time intensity.

kayzo.note: LA bass-music DJ who built his name on hardstyle/dubstep/trap crossover and has recently leaned back into hard dance and hard techno — aggressive, riddim-adjacent, not a selector's night.

blksoap.note: DJ, educator, and Soul Source LA co-founder (also runs Textures) — deep, eclectic sets spanning house, beats and '90s R&B/neo-soul; the resident anchoring this monthly.

kobie dozier.note: LA jazz saxophonist out of the Leimert Park scene (studied with Ricky Washington, Kamasi Washington-adjacent lineage) — his billing here points to a live-jazz element in the room, not a straight DJ set.

shanto.note: LA-based DJ/producer ranging downtempo through deep and indie house to techno — a regular on the city's rooftop/deep-house circuit.

young franco.note: Brisbane-raised, Sydney-based producer (Joseph Da Rin de Barbera) — ARIA-certified pop-leaning dance songs ('Drop Your Love,' a Magic Mike's Last Dance cut), Apple/EA/NFL sync placements. Big, sunny, festival-friendly rather than underground; good-time daytime pool set energy.

okayval.note: Colombian-born, US-based rising DJ/producer blending techno and tech house — Beatport/SoundCloud presence but too new for a fuller bio; billed as the headliner here.

silvertone.note: Philadelphia house/techno producer working minimal tech, bass house and acid — early-career, small footprint, but the sound fits a warehouse late-night.

day thief.note: US DJ/producer (Sophie L) working the underground FLINTA*/queer party circuit out of SF/Oakland and NYC — appears on BASEMENT-adjacent bills; leans dark, all-night warehouse techno.

faited.note: Oakland-based DJ (Fait P) from the Envelope Soundsystem/Eris Drew-Octo Octa orbit — underground queer techno and house circuit, more soundsystem-culture than festival-facing.

township rebellion.note: Berlin/Cologne techno-house duo (Stil vor Talent, Suara) — shadowy, vocal-accented melodic techno that helped shape the Lane 8/Afterlife-adjacent sound; broke wider after a 2019 Burning Man set connected them to Rufus Du Sol's camp.

denyc.note: LA-based artist (Denise Poole) blending live vocals with dance-heavy basslines — still emerging, limited track record.

fun2bjane.note: LA DJ (Jane O'Conner) — INCOGNITO and Sensory Signal resident who's played HARD Summer and Skyline; sets bounce between sassy house/techno and late-'90s prog/trance.

etari.note: LA-based (Orange County-raised) producer and AUNTIE co-founder — house through trance and techno, with releases on 100% Silk; regular on the Lights Down Low/HARD Summer circuit.

rosie love.note: LA underground DJ tied to the Apt4B Radio scene — spins house and techno; limited wider public profile beyond local bookings.

mike servito.note: Detroit-bred, NY-based DJ and longtime Bunker NYC resident — jacking, unpretentious sets that move fluidly through house, acid and techno; a fixture of the queer-underground warehouse circuit for two-plus decades.

jason kendig.note: Detroit-vet DJ and one-quarter of San Francisco's Honey Soundsystem crew — deep, eclectic house/techno selection; frequent Servito collaborator (Honcho, The Black Madonna's We Still Believe tour).

apt4b radio.note: LA collective throwing intimate, no-phones-on-the-floor house/techno/UKG parties in apartments, lofts and small venues — community-first, BIPOC/queer-forward lineups over marquee names.

mura masa.note: Guernsey-born producer Alex Crossan — future bass/alt-R&B crossover, Grammy-nominated for his 2017 debut LP; also produces for Ariana Grande and PinkPantheress. This is a DJ set, not the full live production.

zepparella.note: All-female Led Zeppelin tribute band out of San Francisco (formed 2005) — no original material, note-for-note recreations with genuine musicianship.

adam spry.note: Bay Area indie-folk/alt-rock songwriter, likened to The Shins and Fruit Bats — plays warm, nostalgic guitar pop.

the pretty flowers.note: LA indie-rock four-piece led by Noah Green, three albums in (most recent 'Never Felt Bitter' on Forge Again Records, 2026) — hooky, literate underground rock, well-regarded on the local circuit.

markus schulz.note: German-American trance veteran (Coldharbour Recordings founder, longtime top-10 DJ Mag placement) — progressive trance with techno and D&B influences. Well outside the house/techno lane; a big trance name, not a groove/European-house one.

beau didier.note: Amsterdam DJ/producer (b. 1999) and Vulged co-founder — bass-heavy, vocal-driven hard groove/techno; releases on Molekül and Mutual Rytm, plays HÖR Berlin and Awakenings. Making his LA debut here.

ötak.note: Recurring THERMAL support DJ — hard/industrial techno, releases on 44 Label Group and Dolma Records; a known quantity on this specific TBA-warehouse circuit rather than a marquee name.

kyrxmi.note: Phoenix-via-LA techno DJ, EvilGroove label affiliate — deep, driving, hypnotic groove techno; plays the Southern California TBA-warehouse circuit.

kana hishiya.note: Japan-born, LA-based DJ/producer — house and techno moving between punchy, minimal and broken-beat, with dreamy melodic turns; played MEOKO and Sirens LA podcast series.

bilaliwood.note: NYC/LA DJ, ex-child actor — plays tasteful, left-of-center selections across genres; regular on the DāM-Funk/Fusicology TBA-party orbit.

stavroz.note: Belgian four-piece live band — organic, cinematic electronic music blending acoustic textures with emotive melodies (breakout tracks 'The Finishing,' 'Gold Town'); Coachella and Pukkelpop alumni, half a million-plus monthly Spotify listeners. A live act, not a DJ set.

orion 224.note: Houston indie/alt-rock four-piece (formed 2016) fronted by Cristian Gonzalez — melodic guitar-driven indie rock.

cannon the dealers.note: Brownsville, TX 'indie-sleaze' four-piece — nostalgic early-2000s indie rock/shoegaze/hardcore blend, Strokes/Red Pears lineage; touring behind their album 'Still Too Soon.'

dj slugo.note: Chicago ghetto-house/footwork pioneer, founding Dance Mania crew alongside DJ Deeon and Paul Johnson — raw, high-BPM, chant-hook club tracks; the sound Daft Punk sampled on 'Teachers.'

scotty boy.note: Vegas-based house veteran (25+ years, three Billboard Dance #1s) and founder of DTLA's long-running 'Deep House Brunch' — plays crowd-friendly deep/jackin' house and nu-disco edits, more festival-polish than underground digger.

nikki nair.note: Atlanta producer/DJ blending techno, electro, breaks and UK bass into something genre-agnostic and physical — releases on Dirtybird and Lobster Theremin, mentored early by Underground Resistance's Mike Banks.

george daniel.note: The 1975's drummer moonlighting as a dance producer/DJ — founded the label dh2 out of afterparty DJ sets; plays bass-leaning, UK-rap-inflected electronic sets, not a genre veteran but a genuine crate-digger's side project.

embrz.note: Dublin producer (Jack Casey) making atmospheric, vocal-forward melodic house — signed to Lane 8's This Never Happened label; downtempo-leaning and emotive rather than peak-time.

isaac carter.note: London DJ/producer, vocal-led deep house on his own Ochi imprint — championed by Ben UFO, Joy Orbison and Seth Troxler; UK-club lineage (Chicago/Detroit roots filtered through contemporary UK dance).

lubelski.note: LA producer (Jake Lubell) making analog, vinyl-informed house with a wide festival footprint (Lightning in a Bottle, Desert Hearts, Dirtybird Campout) — eclectic and percussive rather than a strict selector.

phantoms.note: LA duo (Kyle Kaplan, Vinnie Pergola) blurring house and indie-dance — 'alternative electronic,' now on Foreign Family, ODESZA's label. Bigger-room, hooky and radio-adjacent rather than a selector's set.

dj rashida.note: Rashida Gonzalez Robinson — spent a decade as Prince's touring/opening DJ and played his private parties; genuinely the person to trust with a Prince set, not a stunt booking.

man man.note: Philadelphia-born experimental rock band led by Honus Honus (Ryan Kattner) — theatrical, maximalist arrangements (sousaphone, marimba, toy noisemakers) somewhere between carnival music and art-punk. Toured with Modest Mouse; now LA-based.

american tomahawk.note: LA indie/alt-rock trio (not the Mike Patton supergroup of the same-ish name) — small local footprint, couldn't verify much beyond the billing.

norwood fisher.note: Fishbone's bassist/co-founder for four decades — funk-punk-metal crossover pioneer; Blackened Sabbath is his project reworking Black Sabbath's catalog through a Black-rock lens with a rotating band of heavy-scene players.

hydeclip.note: Barcelona-rooted producer (releases via 48 Records, AH Digital, Kosà) who folds Latin and Middle Eastern melodic textures into tech-house/progressive sets — a global-groove angle on this bill, not a big name.

felix da housecat.note: Chicago house lifer turned electroclash figurehead — mentored by acid-house originator DJ Pierre in the '80s, ran Radikal Fear Records through the '90s, then broke big with 2001's 'Kittenz and Thee Glitz' (with Miss Kittin), which more or less wrote the electroclash playbook. Deep discography of remixes for Madonna/Britney from that era too.

dj noir.note: LA selector (Phyliss Jaxson) affiliated with Juke Bounce Werk and dublab's radio community — footwork/juke and bass-leaning sets.

boo lean.note: Lauren Goshinski — NYC/LA selector, VIA Festival co-founder, now a Public Records/Lot Radio resident; eclectic, genre-blurring sets moving through dub, drum-play and melodic vocal house.

spiñorita.note: Angela Ramirez — Alhambra-raised Chicana DJ and host of NTS's Casual Play; disco, house, funk and vinyl-digging roots, a fixture of LA's underground/backyard party scene since 2010.

lil texas.note: Texas producer behind 'Texcore' — 200+ BPM gabber/Frenchcore fused with Southern rave theatrics; released on Masters of Hardcore and Barong Family, did the 2021 Gaga/Elton John hardcore remix. Also runs a slower techno alias, Diamond Dallas.

vilena.note: LA-based DJ/producer playing groovy, deep, driving techno with a progressive edge; featured on Spectrum Radio's global techno platform — a solid underground booking, not a marquee name.

jody wisternoff.note: Bristol DJ/producer, one half of veteran duo Way Out West, and a co-curator of Anjunadeep's flagship annual mix series — deep, melodic progressive house that's exactly the Anjuna-adjacent sound this rooftop lane runs on.

vltra it.note: Sicilian tech-house duo (Samuele Giambona & Riccardo Anzalone) — Beatport-chart regulars since 'Zilla' on Lee Foss's Repopulate Mars, collabs with The Martinez Brothers and Loco Dice, now touring Tomorrowland/Elrow-tier stages.

chambord.note: LA-based DJ/production duo — eclectic, melodic sets pulling in world-music textures alongside more hypnotic electronic passages; a reasonable fit for FLOAT's rooftop-groove daytime format.

pegassi.note: Belgian producer (Sam Huybrecht) running his own label/party series Sweet Nothing — a deliberately 'post-genre' set that swings between trance, techno, eurodance and house rather than staying in a lane. Closer to a big-room selector than a groove/disco DJ.

massane.note: French melodic-house producer and guitarist — debut EP and album on Lane 8's This Never Happened, plus a release on mau5trap. Guitar-textured, emotive melodic house that sits right next to the Anjunadeep/Lane 8 end of the spectrum.

maddix.note: Dutch producer known for a hard-hitting techno/big-room/trance crossover (breakout track 'Ecstasy'), Revealed Recordings-affiliated. Mainstage-built and harder-edged than the refined techno end of the lane (Charlotte de Witte, Amelie Lens) — closer to festival trance-techno.

jason bonham.note: John Bonham's son and a drummer in his own right — leads this touring recreation of the Led Zeppelin catalog with full band and visual production. About as legitimate as a non-original-lineup Zeppelin show gets, but it's still a legacy/tribute-format night, not a new act.

beltran.note: Rising tech-house producer known for driving, percussive sets rooted in Brazilian/Latin rhythm and low-end groove — co-signed by FISHER, Chris Lake and Michael Bibi. Squarely the mainstream-but-tasteful tech-house lane.

oguz.note: Dutch-Turkish techno DJ/producer — high-tempo, hard-driving peak-time techno, a regular on the international festival/club circuit. Refined-end-of-techno rather than melodic.

noizu.note: UK-born, now LA-based tech-house producer (real name Jacob Plant) — runs his own label TECHNE Records, broke through via Chris Lake/Skrillex's HOWSLA and the platinum single 'Summer 91.' Crowd-pleasing but well-crafted house/tech-house, the mainstream end of the lane this taste explicitly wants.

durante.note: Italian-born, LA-based progressive/melodic house producer on Anjunadeep — hypnotic, groove-driven sets sitting between deep house and techno; released his debut album 'Enter' on Anjunadeep in 2024, collaborators include Amtrac and Diplo. Same melodic/Anjuna orbit as Lane 8 and Yotto.

die spitz.note: All-female Austin punk band (signed to Jack White's Third Man Records) known for riotous, chaotic live shows — has opened for Foo Fighters, Amyl and the Sniffers, and Sleater-Kinney.

rachel chinouriri.note: London-born, Zimbabwean-British indie/alt-pop singer-songwriter — 2024 debut album charted UK top 20, two BRIT nominations; toured with Sabrina Carpenter.

dj susan.note: Alias of Steven Glathe (Hood Politics Records, San Diego) — bass/tech-house built for big builds and gritty drops, several Beatport #1s. More festival-EDM energy than a groove selector.

bayymack.note: LA-based artist blending hip-hop, pop and rock (alt-hip-hop/'scene' crossover — collabs with 6arelyhuman, Lil Raven) — not a DJ/producer in the house-techno sense.

apache.note: Miami-based, French-born DJ/producer on Abracadabra Records (Miami house/techno label) and founder of the Soundtuary party series — warm, groove-driven house suited to a rooftop-pool crowd.

rich medina.note: Philly institution, 25+ years in — founder of Jump n Funk (North America's original Afrobeat party) and one of the great genre-agnostic all-night selectors, moving through house, soul, afrobeat, funk, breaks and rare groove.

dublon.note: Oslo producer/DJ who went viral on TikTok with jazz-inflected house ('Summer in Marseile,' 'belle') — his 'Nectar' EP features jazz saxophonist Nathan Haines; real touring history across European clubs (London's Jazz Café) despite the social-media breakout.

gabriella rose.note: Coeur d'Alene singer-songwriter blending vintage country, indie folk and pop — broke through as the featured vocalist on Zach Bryan's 'Madeline.' Opening this leg of Kacey's tour.

estevie.note: LA-based mainstream-pop artist — catchy, hooky songwriting, not a name outside pop-radio circles. Opening this second DTLA date on Kacey's tour.

pigeons playing ping pong.note: Baltimore funk/jam band — extended improvisational jams over a funk-rock base, built around a dedicated touring jam-scene fanbase rather than club culture.

uffie.note: French-American vocalist/rapper from the mid-2000s Ed Banger bloghouse wave ('Pop the Glock') — ran with Justice, SebastiAn, Mr Oizo; this is a nostalgia-circuit booking, not a current club regular.

mia moretti.note: LA-based DJ and fixture of the disco/indie-dance/celebrity-party circuit (also plays in the band When Sober) — genre-hopping sets heavy on disco and electro-pop, not deep house.

blakkat.note: Mark Bell — LA house scene veteran, co-founded Shaboom Records with Doc Martin in '96; classically-schooled sets running Chicago acid through deep NY house.

corey sizemore.note: LA/SF DJ, co-founder and resident of Lights Down Low alongside Richie Panic; eclectic house-and-techno sets, Boiler Room alum.

richie panic.note: Founder of Lights Down Low (also Frisco Disco, Blow Up) — the LA promoter behind this exact series, known for genre-blurring 'weird' house and techno bills.

blerry.note: LA underground DJ/producer working peak-time house and techno — a regular on the city's afters circuit, known for adding visual/interactive touches to sets.

jaxx noveira.note: Dutch-born, now LA-based DJ/producer — high-energy tech-house; came up in the club circuit starting 2019 after leaving the military.

shredy.note: LA-born DJ and co-founder of Penthouse Boogie — sets crossing house, disco, electro and techno.

colette.note: Chicago-born, LA-based house DJ and singer-songwriter — a fixture of the 2000s vocal-house scene (Aphrodisiac/Om Records orbit); sings live over her own disco- and italo-leaning house sets.

inland groove.note: Inland Empire-rooted DJ/producer collective (est. 2023) known for gritty, no-frills afterhours parties — sets range from minimal/dark techno to Latin-rhythm-driven grooves; releases on Goodbeats and Space Yacht.

red axes.note: Tel Aviv duo (Dori Sadovnik & Niv Arzi) — psychedelic disco and post-punk-inflected house/techno; own label Garzen Records plus releases on Permanent Vacation, Multi Culti, Crosstown Rebels and ESP Institute. Not European by geography but squarely that eclectic groove/disco-digger end of the lane.

club tularosa.note: LA duo (Ray Barragan & Lionel Rifkin) who cut their teeth at La Cita's long-running La Nuit disco night — Italo disco, post-punk and psychedelic techno, signed to Man Power's UK imprint Me Me Me.

nightshift blind tiger.note: Flagship afterhours series from the Blind Tiger collective at their 129 E 3rd St DTLA speakeasy — secret, unannounced DJ lineups and a real house-music-first afterhours (alley entrance, no phones/LEDs), not a bottle-service room.

river moon.note: Cape Town-born, now LA-based DJ/producer (aka Saint Deepthroat) — genre-blurring rave sets spanning techno, hyperpop and house; Boiler Room alum with real crossover credibility.

shane thomas.note: LA producer/DJ, Ace Hotel-residency host of the party blush! — experimental house and techno spliced with reggaeton, dancehall and ballroom edits.

rob aquino.note: Silver Lake-based promoter (co-runs the monthly Loose party with Bebe) — a fixture of LA's queer underground, mixing techno, house and pop into something weirder than a straight dance set.

bebe.note: Co-throws Loose and this recurring Panic Room series alongside Rob Aquino — a regular on LA's queer party circuit.

jeremy sole.note: KCRW DJ/host — 30+ years digging vinyl across house, Afro-Latin, funk and global grooves; runs the 'Bajo' residency at this same Airliner series. An eclectic, trustworthy selector rather than a straight house/techno headliner.

cam miles.note: LA-based producer/DJ; couldn't verify a specific genre lineage or label history beyond this booking — take at face value.

love gang.note: Denver rock 'n' roll band (formed 2015) touring in support of Wolfmother — riff-heavy garage/stoner rock, a sensible opener for the bill.

mr palomar.note: Unclear whether this billing is a DJ alias or the title of the paired screening (reads like a nod to Calvino's novel) — couldn't verify which, so take the italo disco set as the safer bet on the night.

paul edge.note: UK-born techno DJ/producer active since the mid-'90s (ran the Outer Limits parties, released on Belgium's Nitric Records) — H7o co-founder bringing a proper acid/techno sensibility to LA's Westside.

crispin b side.note: Crispin Barrymore — H7o co-founder and resident, part of the British-expat crew behind the night; couldn't verify a wider production/label history beyond H7o.

dasheera.note: H7o resident (alongside Jimmy Bell) — known for laying unpredictable foundations early in sets rather than playing it safe.

louie vega.note: One half of the legendary Masters at Work (with Kenny 'Dope' Gonzalez) — Grammy-winning NYC house royalty since the late '80s; deep, soulful, Latin-inflected house that's basically a genre unto itself.

karizma.note: Baltimore house/club legend (Kris Klayton) — bridges Baltimore club's raw energy with deep, soulful house edits; a foundational figure in that city's dance scene.

dj sneak.note: Chicago house OG ('the Turntable Terrorist') — jacking, sample-heavy garage-house going back to the early-'90s Cajmere/Relief era, still DJing at that level today.

heidi lawden.note: LA-via-London selector who cut her teeth in the '90s UK queer rave scene — house/techno/disco marathon sets (an 8-hour solo warehouse set till 8am) and a longtime DJ Harvey tour collaborator/muse. Also on the Defected boardwalk afterparty this batch.

jumpin jack frost.note: UK jungle OG from the Kool FM pirate-radio days of the early '90s — one of the genre's founding voices, later took it mainstream via a long-running BBC 1Xtra drum & bass show.

ray keith.note: British jungle pioneer (aka Renegade) — his 1994 track 'Terrorist' is one of the genre's foundational records; Dread Recordings label boss and still a heavyweight on the old-school jungle circuit.

star eyes.note: NYC-via-LA bass polymath — Trouble & Bass crew co-founder turned Chaos Clan/Warp Mode; jungle, UK garage and Baltimore/Jersey club roots, played Fabric London and Outlook Festival.

phayla.note: LA drum & bass DJ/producer active in the local jungle scene, leaning minimal and soulful — couldn't confirm much beyond that, so treat it as a supporting name.

lenny kaye.note: Patti Smith's longtime guitarist since the Patti Smith Group's mid-'70s CBGB days, and the compiler of the seminal 'Nuggets' garage-rock anthology that basically canonized proto-punk — deep New York rock history in a small room.

cindy lee berryhill.note: Singer-songwriter often called the 'godmother of anti-folk' from the 1980s NYC scene — plainspoken, literary folk-rock.

boris brejcha.note: German techno institution known for his masked persona and 'high-tech minimal' sound — hyper-precise, cinematic techno on his own Fckng Serious label; this Bowl date pairs his set with a live orchestra, a genuine novelty booking.

kim gordon.note: Sonic Youth co-founder now several solo albums deep into a genuinely strange run — industrial-tinged, spoken-word noise-rock, not a legacy-act victory lap.

sasami.note: LA multi-instrumentalist (Sasami Ashworth, ex-Cherry Glazerr) whose solo project has swung from dream-pop to full metal — a real opener, not filler.

stephan bodzin.note: German melodic-techno mainstay known for full live hardware/modular sets — cinematic, emotive techno in the Afterlife/Tale of Us vein, running his own Herzblut label since 2006.

eartheater.note: Brooklyn experimental/avant-pop artist (Alexandra Drewchin) on PAN Records — genre-collapsing production spanning noise, folk and glitchy pop; a genuinely singular live performer, more art-show than club night.

bad brains.note: DC hardcore-punk originators who fused breakneck hardcore with dub/reggae starting in the late '70s — one of the most influential bands in the genre's history.

flying lotus.note: LA producer (Steven Ellison), Brainfeeder label founder and Alice Coltrane's grand-nephew — glitchy, jazz-fusion instrumental hip-hop that shaped the modern LA beat scene. This date is billed with a live band, not just a DJ set.

riva starr.note: Italian house/tech-house institution and Snatch! Records boss — sample-flipping, bass-heavy house going back to the mid-2000s; a true Defected/European club-circuit regular.

offaiah.note: UK house/nu-disco production duo on Defected/Glitterbox — glossy, disco-tinged house built for exactly this kind of party.

gene farris.note: Chicago house lifer since the early '90s (Cajual/Relief lineage) — percussive, jacking house with a big-room edge; a long Defected/Repopulate Mars catalog.

carlos souffront.note: Detroit-rooted, San Francisco-based DJ closely tied to Interdimensional Transmissions' No Way Back parties — one of the most respected, genuinely eclectic selectors in American underground dance music (house, techno, acid and post-punk all in one set).

pretty gay friendly.note: LA queer-scene DJ (Anthony, aka PS/LA) — Dublab and Love.Affair.LA resident, a fixture of the current queer underground circuit.

tauceti fr.note: French techno/ambient producer with a growing profile in that scene — couldn't pin down a label home, so treat this as a promising rather than proven booking.

mha iri.note: Edinburgh-raised, Melbourne-forged techno DJ/producer — big-room-meets-emotional sound with her own vocals, now signed to PIAS and releasing on Adam Beyer's Drumcode; genuinely on the rise (Awakenings, Tomorrowland, Hï Ibiza in the last year).

gerard not gerald.note: Co-founder and resident of INCOGNITO itself (formerly Franco Benito) — has held down LA's underground techno scene for over a decade, sharing decks with Kevin Saunderson, Kenny Larkin and DJ Pierre.

cinthie.note: Berlin house DJ/producer with Chicago-lineage roots, founder of the Beste Modus label — raw, jacking, classicist house; exactly the European club-scene name in this lane, and a genuinely excellent free-party booking.

lavenge.note: West LA house DJ/producer (real name-ish alias, 'Love & Revenge') and CEO of JUPTR events — plays open-format but leans house on the local club circuit.

max rush.note: St. Petersburg-born, LA-based producer working minimal deep tech and house/tech-house — active on the local warehouse/afters circuit.

travis holcombe.note: Former KCRW on-air host who ran FREAKS ONLY, the station's underground dance show (guest mixes from Soulwax, HAAi, Bolis Pupul, Nikki Nair) — a genuine curator's ear, moving through post-punk, disco, house and global club rhythms rather than a straight top-40 set.

satoshi kon.note: Director of Perfect Blue (1997) — the anime psychological-thriller touchstone that visibly influenced Requiem for a Dream and Black Swan; this was his feature debut.

klaudia gawlas.note: Poland-born, Germany-based techno DJ/producer running her own label Illusion Recordings — voted Faze Magazine's Best International DJ (2024); hard, emotionally-charged peak-time techno, regular at Loveland and Awakenings.

gigi.note: LA-based acid/techno DJ (Colombian-born, LA-raised), founder of the Fixvtion party — part of the INCOGNITO/Raw Cuts local acid-techno crew.

max cooper.note: UK electronic composer with a PhD in computational biology — his 3D/AV Live show pairs the new Feeling Is Structure album with an immersive light/visual system built per-venue; sits closer to a neo-classical/techno crossover concert than a club DJ set.

rich nxt.note: East London producer, a FUSE resident who helped shape that brand's rise — runs two vinyl imprints (NxT Records, What NxT) and plays with a distinctive groove-and-swing feel.

nu zau.note: Bucharest-based minimal-techno producer, co-runs Uvar with fellow Romanian Sepp — dark, percussive, funky and quirky, released on Fear Of Flying and Archipel.

txhldem.note: Minimal/deep-tech producer on Dialed Records (the same label throwing this showcase) — part of the label's current roster alongside Josh Lee and Tyke.

corbin.note: Moody alt-R&B artist (formerly recorded as Spooky Black) out of the Minnesota World's Fair/Psymun/Bones orbit — hazy, downtempo vocal music, not a DJ or electronic act.

plush managements inc.note: The joint alias of D. Tiffany and Regularfantasy — their long-running 'plush' side-project blending soft, R&B-tinged textures into breaks and house; not a separate third artist.
